paribāhira.cp: adj. external or an alien to; outsider.

C: paribāhira：[adj．] external or an alien to； outsider．
P: Paribāhira，（adj．） [pari+bāhira] external，alien to； an outsider Vin．II，140； IV，283； S．I，126； J．I，482； III，213； Nd<sup>1</sup> 144； （parimussati p．hoti，in expl<sup>n</sup> of mussati） Vism．54； PvA．131； ThA．204； DA．I，30．（Page 430）
R:
paribāhira：ပရိ-ဗာဟိရ （တိ）
အပြင်အပဖြစ်သော။
DOP: paribāhira mfn. [ BHS id. ], outside; deprived of, separated from; excluded; Abh 703 (bāhiraṃ ~aṃ); Vin I 177, 7 (evaṃ mayaṃ imamhā phāsuvihārā ~ā bhavissāma; Sp 1080, 7 foll.: bhāvanānuyogaṃ sampādetuṃ asakkontā bāhirā bhavissāma); II 140, 24 (api nu kho bhikkhave taṃ khāditabbaṃ yaṃ khāditvā evarūpāya dhammakathāya ~o assā ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be paribāhiyo); 168, 22 (evaṃ tvaṃ moghapurisa ubhayattha ~o, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr paṭibāhiro); IV 283, 19 (ubhayen’ amhā ~ā bhogehi ca puññena cā ti); S I 126, 24* (kathaṃ jhāyaṃ bahulaṃ kāmasaññā ~ā honti aladdha yo taṃ); Th 943 (saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti saṅghato ~ā; Th-a III 80, 9 : ariyasaṅghato bahibhūtā); Thī 243 (puññaṃ p’ imā vaheyyuṃ tena tvaṃ ~o assa; Thī-a 196, 20 : virahito va bhaveyyā ti); Ja I 482, 22 (Devadatto … ubhato ~o jāto gihiparibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññattaṃ ca na paripūretī ti); Nidd I 143, 31 (idaṃ pariyattisāsanaṃ, taṃ pi mussati parimussati, ~o hotī ti; Nidd-a I 270, 25 : parammukho hoti); 462, 19 (sacāhaṃ na paṭiggahessāmi evaṃ tumhe puññena ~ā bhavissatha); Vism 306, 2 (sace tvaṃ idaṃ cittaṃ na nibbāpessasi imehi ānisaṃsehi ~o bhavissasī ti); Sp 787, 13 (te bhikkhuni-ovādato ~e kattukāmo); 1367, 25 (hiriyā °-ttā ahiriko); Ps II 258, 28 (tassa gogaṇo pi parihāyati pañcagorasaparibhogato pi ~o hoti); 262, 4 (pañcahi dhammakkhandhehi ~o hoti); Mp III 44, 8 (adhiggahitā honti antogatā na ~ā ti); Pv-a 131, 7 (adānena hi samparāyikato atthato ~o hoti); As 29, 6 (satthā ābhidhammikā nāma mama sāsane ~ā ti avatvā).

P: Paribandha，at ThA．242 is C．reading for paripantha at Th．2，352； also at Vism．147，152．（Page 430）

paribandha：ပရိ-ဗန္ဓ （ပ）

DOP: paribandha m. ( and mfn. ?) [ cf S. pari√bandh?], (being) an obstruction; Th 1152 (tava sarīraṃ navasotaṃ duggandhakaraṃ ~aṃ bhikkhu parivajjayate taṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee duggandhaṃ kariparibandha; Se duggandhakaṃ parivajjeyya; Th-a III 167, 28 : ~an ti sammāpaṭipattiparibandhabhūtaṃ; or read karīsaparibandhaṃ with Th App II, p. 237, 20 ?); Th-a II 208, 2 (samaṇadhammakaraṇassa °-bhūtaṃ mahantaṃ navakammaṃ na paṭṭhapeyya, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee paripantha-).
